selection_confidence.label: Strong selection
selection_confidence.summary: CatBoost was selected because it ranked first under the configured model-selection rule, which prioritizes the lowest average four-horizon RMSE. MAE and cumulative RMSE are used only as tie-breakers. This heuristic selection-strength score is not a probability that the forecast is correct.

metrics.selection_explanation: CatBoost was selected because it achieved the lowest average four-horizon RMSE (2.2449) under the configured ranking rule. Each candidate was evaluated separately for Periods 1 through 4, with average RMSE as the primary selection criterion; MAE and cumulative RMSE are used as tie-breakers. Ridge Regression produced the lowest average MAE (1.0625), while CatBoost had MAE 1.1311. The next closest model by RMSE was Random Forest with average RMSE 2.268.
